title: TOOLS-001: The property parsers build `sscanf()` formats with field widths equal to destination buffer sizes, which still leaves room for a terminating NUL beyond the array
summary: TOOLS-001: The property parsers build `sscanf()` formats with field widths equal to destination buffer sizes, which still leaves room for a terminating NUL beyond the array. The remote-server parser also uses `%[^:]:%s` with no widths for `hostname[255]` and `port_str[100]`. Exact-size or long command-line arguments can overflow stack/global buffers before validation. Use bounded widths of `sizeof(buffer) - 1`, check `item_count < MAX_ITEMS` before appending parsed items, and reject overlong fields. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.
